The day view is the cockpit: the Daily Intelligence Report, Intel Today, daily notes, daily smart notes, daily news (local, provincial, global), and daily action (business, personal, thing) — all for that day, on that day. The calendar round now carries it as an explicit check: the day view has to show all of it for that day, not just the menu buttons.
